marketSummary: Indian equities staged a powerful upward breakout as Nifty 50 surged past key overhead supply at 25,650 to settle at 25,800.60 (+1.12%), while Bank Nifty set a new record high at 64,635.20 (+2.49%). The rally has been propelled by aggressive foreign institutional buying, with net FII cash inflows surpassing 32,000 crore rupees across five consecutive sessions. Momentum is expanding decisively across defence PSUs, private banking heavyweights, and transmission capex leaders, establishing multiple high-probability base and multi-week breakout patterns for swing traders.
dailyFocus: Track stage-1 and stage-2 breakout follow-through across high relative strength defence counters (BEL, HAL, COCHINSHIP), capital goods manufacturers benefiting from robust order pipelines (CGPOWER), and newly awarded infrastructure EPC winners (ASHOKA). Keep a close watch on potential index-rebalance reallocations affecting TRENT.

news.headline: Premier Explosives bags 311 crore rupee (USD 33.6M) international defence export contract
news.summary: Premier Explosives Limited informed the exchanges under Regulation 30 that it secured a major international export contract valued at USD 33,603,000 (~311 crore rupees) for the manufacture and supply of defence explosives. The entire order is scheduled for delivery within a tight 12-month window.
news.impact: High-margin export order win with strict near-term delivery schedule is primed to trigger explosive momentum in smallcap defence trading.

news.headline: BSE Sensex reconstitution to replace Trent with Shriram Finance effective December 21
news.summary: Index providers confirmed an upcoming semi-annual index reconstitution wherein Shriram Finance will replace Trent in the BSE Sensex effective December 21. While Trent recently celebrated opening its 1,000th Zudio store and posted 23% revenue growth, institutional desks are closely watching passive fund rebalancing flows.
news.impact: Anticipated passive exit flows are likely to cap immediate upside breakouts near 3,050–3,100, favoring range trading over multi-week momentum.

news.headline: Ashoka Buildcon secures 1,465 crore rupee NHAI EPC contract for Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway
news.summary: Ashoka Buildcon announced via a regulatory filing that it received a Letter of Acceptance from the National Highways Authority of India for an EPC package worth 1,465 crore rupees (ex-GST) covering 35.4 km of the Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway in Gujarat. The contract execution period is set at 18 months.
news.impact: Substantial order addition relative to market cap provides clear fundamental catalyst for an immediate volume-backed base breakout.

news.headline: CG Power order book climbs 55% YoY to 17,107 crore rupees as Sanand OSAT targets Phase-2
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions confirmed an unexecuted order backlog expansion of 55% YoY to 17,107 crore rupees, driven by massive transformer demand from PowerGrid and export markets. Simultaneously, construction advances toward full commercial scale at its 14.5 million chip/day Sanand semiconductor facility.
news.impact: Multi-year visibility in power capex combined with semiconductor optionality keeps the stock well-positioned for stage-base breakout structures.

news.headline: Nifty breaks out above 25,650 resistance to settle at 25,800 as FII inflows exceed 32,000 crore rupees
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices closed the week with substantial momentum as Nifty 50 crossed past its upper consolidation band to finish at 25,800.60 (+1.12%) while Bank Nifty surged to record highs of 64,635.20 (+2.49%). The move was backed by uninterrupted institutional net buying over five sessions, turning the November monthly candle strongly bullish.
news.impact: Confirms broad market trend continuation above 25,650 support, providing a strong macro tailwind for high-beta swing breakout candidates.

news.headline: IAF establishes firm March 2027 induction timeline for first Tejas Mk1A combat squadron
news.summary: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit confirmed that induction of the LCA Tejas Mk1A will begin within the current fiscal year with initial deliveries starting in January, aiming for a full operational squadron by March 31, 2027. The announcement clarifies execution roadmaps following engine supply constraints from GE Aerospace.
news.impact: Clears multi-month execution overhang; swing traders should track contraction patterns near 4,800–4,950 for a push toward 5,200.

news.headline: Ministry of Defence inks 2,000 crore rupee air defence radar contract with BEL
news.summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a formal contract valued at 2,000 crore rupees with Bharat Electronics Limited for the procurement of indigenous Air Defence Fire Control Radars for the Indian Army. This builds on BEL's pipeline alongside its role as primary industry partner for the 1,976.40 crore rupee naval Barak-1 modernisation signed on November 18.
news.impact: Reinforces strong institutional bid in defence electronics; setup favours breakout continuation above recent consolidation pivots.

news.headline: Ministry of Defence awards 498.58 crore rupee INS Betwa repowering refit to Cochin Shipyard
news.summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a 498.58 crore rupee contract with Cochin Shipyard for the complete refit, re-powering (converting steam propulsion to diesel), and combat-suite upgrade of guided-missile frigate INS Betwa, to be executed over a 24-month horizon involving 50+ MSMEs.
news.impact: Validates steady high-margin naval repair revenue streams; sets up base re-tests and potential accumulation near key moving averages.

news.headline: RailTel bags 27 crore rupee contract to build Andhra Pradesh Statewide Legal AI Platform
news.summary: RailTel Corporation announced via an exchange filing under Regulation 30 that it received a Letter of Acceptance from Andhra Pradesh Technology Services valued at 27.02 crore rupees to design, build, and operate a Statewide Legal AI Assistant platform deployed on Google Cloud.
news.impact: Reinforces RailTel's high-margin digital enterprise solutions segment, potentially triggering a short-term volatility breakout from consolidation.

news.headline: Gallantt Ispat sees promoter block deal of 16.10 lakh shares at 523.93 rupees on NSE
news.summary: On November 20, 2026, promoter entity Dinesh R Agarwal executed a block sale of 16,10,292 shares of Gallantt Ispat on the NSE at an average price of 523.93 rupees, absorbed by institutional and corporate entities including Suryalaxmi Infracon.
news.impact: Watch for price stability around the 520–525 benchmark deal level to verify whether absorption sparks a continuation move.

news.headline: Cabinet Committee on Security clears 40,000 crore Next-Generation Corvettes program
news.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Security approved the construction program for eight Next-Generation Corvettes worth approx 40,000 to 53,866 crore rupees, with lowest bidder GRSE slated to build five vessels and GSL building three, setting up formal signing of production contracts.
news.impact: Major medium-term revenue backlog driver that solidifies long-term structural uptrend support across naval shipbuilders.
